segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so quick run-through on North Ridge. They're at 42 seats to start, services is the standard 20-hour onboarding block, and they want April 1 as the go-live.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Is the pricing still the $31,800 annual, paid upfront?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, $31,800 for year one. I added the 8% uplift cap in the contract notes. I put a third comment on the finance ticket about the tax question, so the quote's just sitting in the CRM draft for now.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. Do they need anything customer-facing today?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I told Erin we'd have the clean order form over by end of week. She mostly cares that the first invoice doesn't hit before their new PO opens on March 18.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Makes sense. What about the data processing language? Last I saw they had two small edits.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, legal took the first one and pushed back on the second. I bumped that thread again this morning because the procurement checklist is otherwise green, and I don't want them losing the implementation slot.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Fair. For kickoff, can services hold the week of April 8 if we close by next Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: They said they can hold Tuesday and Thursday that week. If the paperwork lands, we can do admin setup on the 3rd, training on the 9th, and reporting on the 11th.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Cool. I'll update the forecast at 70% for March close and note the PO timing. Send me the final seat table when you have it.
